label: Voyage continuation

Every original participant returned with Magellan

label: Aims and practical limits
quiz: Why might another voyage be sent after an earlier difficult one?

What evidence shows the voyage could return and maintain supplies?
Which royal name guarantees success?
Why does an aim prove an outcome?
Why did a departure remove all local choices?

quiz: The name Filipinas is connected with whose expedition and which person honored?

Elcano's return and every local leader
